name: Induszalim
isnote: PBDB places it in Induszalimidae, which has no atlas clade; the group's status is unclear.
sum: Induszalim is a crocodyliform named in 2014 from the Maastrichtian Vitakri Formation of Pakistan.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Two occurrences in the Vitakri Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Malkani 2014
